anemia.title: Anemia Tracker
anemia.subtitle: ICMR-NIN Guidelines
anemia.advice_required: Please provide advice for the patient
anemia.voice_intro: Anemia tracker. Select symptoms and foods consumed. Tap microphone to use voice.
anemia.who_reference: WHO Reference: Normal Hemoglobin in women is above 12 g per decilitre. Pregnancy requires above 11 g per decilitre.
anemia.icmr_tip: ICMR Tip: Eating Vitamin C with iron-rich foods doubles iron absorption.
anemia.advice_good: Great! Iron-rich foods consumed. Add Vitamin C (lemon, amla) to help absorb iron better.
anemia.advice_poor: No iron-rich food today. Please advise patient to have spinach, jaggery, or beans.

ppd.title: PPD Screening
ppd.subtitle: Answer based on feelings in the past 7 days
ppd.result_medium: Discuss with supervisor. Schedule follow-up visit.
ppd.result_high: Immediate referral to doctor required. Do not leave patient alone.
ppd.epds_tip: EPDS (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale): Validated screening tool. Score ≥10 needs monitoring. Score ≥13 requires referral.
ppd.voice_instruction: I will read each question. After I finish speaking, answer by saying Never, Not often, Sometimes, or Yes.
questions: I have been able to laugh and see the funny side of things
I have looked forward with enjoyment to things
I have blamed myself unnecessarily when things went wrong
I have been anxious or worried for no good reason
I have felt scared or panicky for no very good reason
Things have been getting on top of me
I have been so unhappy that I have had difficulty sleeping
I have felt sad or miserable
I have been so unhappy that I have been crying
The thought of harming myself has occurred to me

risk.title: Pregnancy Risk
risk.subtitle: WHO/ICMR evidence-based risk scoring
risk.who_bp_threshold: WHO: BP ≥140/90 mmHg in pregnancy = gestational hypertension requiring referral.
risk.icmr_hb_threshold: ICMR: Hemoglobin below 11 g/dL in pregnancy = anemia requiring iron supplementation.
risk.voice_result: Assessment complete. Risk level is {{risk}}. {{reasons}} action points identified.
risk.voice_intro: Pregnancy risk assessment. Enter the patient details, then tap Assess Risk for WHO and ICMR based evaluation.

wellness.title: Your Wellness
wellness.privacy_text: All wellness data is stored only on your phone. It is never sent to the backend or cloud. This is your personal well-being space.
wellness.scientific_note: Research shows ASHA workers experience high rates of depression and cognitive issues due to workload. This wellness tracker helps identify stress patterns early. Contact your ANM or federation if stress persists.
